_doc: Paranormal Gates. Built from compact specs; see CLAUDE.md > Gates.

veras_asylum_saint_vera_boss.name: Saint Vera, Who Could Not Save Them

gates.name: Ashgrove Manor
gates.description: A manor house that burned down a century ago stands whole again inside a rift by the village well. Its windows are lit every night.
gates.entry_text: The front door opens before you knock. Portraits follow you with their eyes, and the dust on the floor shows footprints that end mid-step.

rooms.text: Plates fly off the dining table at your head. Something invisible is laughing.
A child's music box sits open on the stairs, playing.

check.success: You let the tune finish before you touch anything. A glob of ectoplasm lies where the music was.
check.fail: You close the lid mid-tune, and the whole house screams at you.

rooms.text: The servants are still laying the table for a dinner party that never came.

ashgrove_manor_lady.title: Lady {name} Ashgrove
ashgrove_manor_lady.intro: A woman in a smouldering ball gown sits at her mirror, brushing hair that is still on fire. 'You're late,' says Lady {name}. 'The guests have been waiting a hundred years.'
ashgrove_manor_lady.victory: Lady {name}'s flames go out, and she looks at her hands, surprised.

study.text: She is bound to the mirror. Turn it to the wall.

aftermath.label: Leave her mirror on the wall.
aftermath.text: Her reflection is still in it, brushing her hair.

aftermath.label: Smash the mirror.
aftermath.text: The glass shatters. Every window in the manor goes dark at once.

ashgrove_manor_reflection.title: the Lady in the Glass
ashgrove_manor_reflection.intro: Her reflection has climbed out of the mirror. It is cold where the lady was burning, and it is very, very angry.
ashgrove_manor_reflection.victory: The Lady in the Glass shatters into a thousand cold pieces.
ashgrove_manor_reflection.arrival_omen: The mirror in the master bedroom is fogged from the inside. A handprint is pressed against the glass.
ashgrove_manor_reflection.arrival_rumour: Ashgrove Manor's lady is gone, but her reflection walks the halls now.

study.text: Everything it does is backwards. Move left to go right.

ashgrove_manor_children.title: the Ashgrove Children
ashgrove_manor_children.intro: With their mother gone, the manor's ghost children have the run of it. They want to play. Their games hurt.
ashgrove_manor_children.victory: Little Master Edmund sits down on the floor and cries, and fades.
ashgrove_manor_children.arrival_omen: Toys are scattered all down the dark hall. A skipping rope turns by itself.
ashgrove_manor_children.arrival_rumour: The ghost children of Ashgrove Manor want visitors. They play hide and seek, and they always find you.

study.text: Children's games have rules. Ask the rules and they must tell you.

ashgrove_manor_butler.title: Hollis the Butler
ashgrove_manor_butler.intro: The household is gone, but the butler is not. Hollis has polished the silver for a hundred years, and he does not care for guests who break things.
ashgrove_manor_butler.victory: Hollis bows as he fades. 'The house is yours, then.'
ashgrove_manor_butler.arrival_omen: The manor is spotless again. Someone has set the table for one.
ashgrove_manor_butler.arrival_rumour: Ashgrove Manor has a butler again. He keeps the house perfect and the guests out.

study.text: He will always stop to straighten something crooked.

gates.name: Grandmother Rook's Bog
gates.description: A rift in the wetlands near the camp, full of crooked trees hung with charms. Livestock in the area have started to vanish.
gates.entry_text: The path is made of bones laid like cobbles. Crows watch you from every branch and do not caw.

rooms.text: A flock of crows descends all at once, silent.
Charms hang over the path. Touch one and something will know.

check.success: You duck under every charm and cut one down cleanly for yourself.
check.fail: You brush a charm, and something in the bog wakes and bites.

rooms.text: Scarecrows stand in a field of dead turnips. They turn their heads.

witchs_bog_rook.title: Grandmother {name}
witchs_bog_rook.intro: An old woman stirs a cauldron outside a crooked cottage. 'Come in, come in, dearie,' says Grandmother {name}. 'You'll fit in the pot quite nicely.'
witchs_bog_rook.victory: Grandmother {name} falls into her own cauldron. The crows all fly away at once.

study.text: Her power is in the cauldron. Tip it over.

witchs_bog_coven.title: the Bog Coven
witchs_bog_coven.intro: Grandmother's apprentices have come to claim her cottage. Three of them, which is the proper number, and they argue constantly.
witchs_bog_coven.victory: Sister Moll falls, and the coven breaks. The others flee into the bog.
witchs_bog_coven.arrival_omen: Three brooms lean against the cottage door. Three cups of tea are steaming inside.
witchs_bog_coven.arrival_rumour: A coven has taken Grandmother Rook's cottage in the bog. The crows are back.

study.text: Three is the proper number. Take one out and the others lose their spell.

witchs_bog_cauldron.title: the Cauldron Thing
witchs_bog_cauldron.intro: Your magic spilled into the witch's cauldron, and the brew got up and walked. It is mostly frog, partly witch, and entirely hungry.
witchs_bog_cauldron.victory: The Cauldron Thing collapses into a puddle of cooling stew.
witchs_bog_cauldron.arrival_omen: The cauldron is bubbling with no fire under it. Something inside it is singing to itself.
witchs_bog_cauldron.arrival_rumour: The witch's cauldron in the bog has come to life. It's eating the sheep.

study.text: It is still boiling. Water would cool it.

witchs_bog_bog_wife.title: the Bog Wife
witchs_bog_bog_wife.intro: Something older than any witch has risen from the mud: a woman of peat and weed, wearing a crown of drowned flowers. The bog belonged to her first.
witchs_bog_bog_wife.victory: The Bog Wife sinks back into the mud, and the bog is quiet.
witchs_bog_bog_wife.arrival_omen: The bog is rising. The cottage is half-sunk, and drowned flowers bloom on the water.
witchs_bog_bog_wife.arrival_rumour: The bog by the camp has woken up. Something in it takes people who walk alone.

study.text: Ask her name. Old things must answer.

gates.name: the Dollmaker's Workshop
gates.description: A toyshop on a Verath side street was swallowed by a rift. Through the window, the dolls on the shelves have been rearranged every morning.
gates.entry_text: Hundreds of porcelain faces watch you from the shelves. A music box plays somewhere, slightly too slow.

rooms.text: The dolls on the bottom shelf climb down, very slowly, all together.
Strings criss-cross the workshop like a web, attached to every doll.

check.success: You weave through without touching a single string, and pick up a broken face on the far side.
check.fail: You brush a string, and every doll in the room turns its head toward you.

rooms.text: Marionettes dance down from the rafters, though no one is holding their strings.

dollmaker_workshop_dollmaker.title: Master Dollmaker {name}
dollmaker_workshop_dollmaker.intro: An old man works at a bench, painting a doll's face that looks exactly like yours. 'Almost finished,' says Master {name}. 'Hold still.'
dollmaker_workshop_dollmaker.victory: The Master falls across his bench. The half-finished doll of you rolls to the floor.

study.text: He controls them with the rings on his fingers. Break the rings.

aftermath.label: Leave the doll that looks like you.
aftermath.text: You don't like how it watches you go.

aftermath.label: Burn the workshop's dolls.
aftermath.text: They scream as they burn. Porcelain doesn't scream, you think, but they do.

dollmaker_workshop_your_doll.title: the Doll Who Wears Your Face
dollmaker_workshop_your_doll.intro: The doll he was making of you has finished itself. It wears your face, your clothes, and your best moves.
dollmaker_workshop_your_doll.victory: Your doll breaks, and its face cracks across your own smile.
dollmaker_workshop_your_doll.arrival_omen: Your own footprints, small and porcelain-light, circle the workbench.
dollmaker_workshop_your_doll.arrival_rumour: The Dollmaker's Workshop has a new doll in the window. People say it looks like an adventurer they know.

study.text: It copies everything you do. Do nothing, then strike.

dollmaker_workshop_ash_puppets.title: the Ash Puppet Theatre
dollmaker_workshop_ash_puppets.intro: The burnt dolls did not stay dead. The charred ones have put on a show in the ashes, led by a ringmaster with a melted smile.
dollmaker_workshop_ash_puppets.victory: The Burnt Ringmaster takes his final bow, and the curtain of ash falls.
dollmaker_workshop_ash_puppets.arrival_omen: A tiny theatre has been built from the ashes of the workshop. Charred tickets lie on the floor.
dollmaker_workshop_ash_puppets.arrival_rumour: The burnt dolls of the Dollmaker's Workshop put on a show every night. Nobody who attends leaves.

study.text: Every show needs an audience. Look away and they lose their strength.

dollmaker_workshop_doll_queen.title: the Doll Queen
dollmaker_workshop_doll_queen.intro: The dolls have made themselves a ruler, a doll of a hundred broken pieces stitched together, and she has decided she would like a real heart.
dollmaker_workshop_doll_queen.victory: The Doll Queen comes apart at every seam, and the other dolls go still.
dollmaker_workshop_doll_queen.arrival_omen: The dolls have been arranged in a court, bowing to an empty throne made of a doll's house.
dollmaker_workshop_doll_queen.arrival_rumour: The dolls in the workshop have a queen now. People hear her calling for a heart.

study.text: She is stitched together. Find a seam.

gates.name: Saint Vera's Asylum
gates.description: An asylum for the sick, abandoned after a plague long ago, has surfaced in a rift outside Verath's walls. Its bell rings for meals no one eats.
gates.entry_text: The halls smell of carbolic and rot. Gurneys sit where they were left, some still with their straps buckled.

rooms.text: Patients in grey gowns shuffle out of their cells, coughing.
The dispensary. Rows of unlabelled bottles, and the air is thick with spores.

check.success: You hold your breath and grab a jar of ash before the spores reach you.
check.fail: The spores get into your lungs. You cough until you see stars.

rooms.text: Orderlies in leather masks come looking for an escaped patient: you.

veras_asylum_doctor.title: the Plague Doctor
veras_asylum_doctor.intro: A figure in a beaked mask bends over the operating table. 'You look unwell,' says the Plague Doctor. 'Lie down. This won't hurt.' It will.
veras_asylum_doctor.victory: The Plague Doctor's mask falls away. There is nothing under it but dried herbs.

study.text: The beak is full of herbs that keep him alive. Rip it off.

veras_asylum_matron.title: Matron {name}
veras_asylum_matron.intro: The ward's matron has taken charge. Matron {name} keeps the patients in their beds, the orderlies in their places, and visitors in restraints.
veras_asylum_matron.victory: Matron {name} falls, still clutching her keys. All the cell doors swing open.
veras_asylum_matron.arrival_omen: The beds have all been made. A schedule is pinned to the theatre door in neat handwriting.
veras_asylum_matron.arrival_rumour: Saint Vera's Asylum has a new Matron. She is very strict about visiting hours.

study.text: She keeps a schedule. When the bell rings, she must go to it.

veras_asylum_saint_vera.title: Saint Vera
veras_asylum_saint_vera.intro: Your magic woke the asylum's patron. Saint Vera died here trying to cure the plague, and her ghost is still trying, on everyone who walks in.
veras_asylum_saint_vera.victory: Saint Vera bows her head. 'I tried,' she says, and is gone.
veras_asylum_saint_vera.arrival_omen: A soft light glows in the theatre. Someone has laid fresh flowers on every bed.
veras_asylum_saint_vera.arrival_rumour: The ghost of Saint Vera walks her asylum again. She heals anyone she touches, whether they want it or not.

study.text: She wants to be told she did enough. Tell her.

veras_asylum_plague.title: the Plague Itself
veras_asylum_plague.intro: The plague that emptied the asylum has gathered into a shape: a grey, coughing mist in the shape of a crowd.
veras_asylum_plague.victory: The Grey Plague scatters like smoke on a fresh wind.
veras_asylum_plague.arrival_omen: The grey dust in the asylum has begun to drift, all in one direction, toward the theatre.
veras_asylum_plague.arrival_rumour: Something in Saint Vera's Asylum is spreading. The guards on Verath's west gate are wearing masks.

study.text: It is only a sickness. Endure it, and it weakens.

gates.name: the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors
gates.description: A carnival tent pitched in a rift in Verath's market district. Everyone who enters comes out swearing they saw themselves die.
gates.entry_text: Your reflection is in every mirror, and in each one it is doing something slightly different. One of them waves.

rooms.text: Two of your reflections step out of the glass. They both think they're the real one.
A maze of mirrors. Only one path is real.

check.success: You follow the reflection that doesn't move and pick a shard from the floor.
check.fail: You walk face-first into a mirror, and your reflection laughs at you.

rooms.text: Mimes press against the glass, then step through it.

hall_of_mirrors_ringmaster.title: the Mirror Ringmaster
hall_of_mirrors_ringmaster.intro: A ringmaster in a silver coat stands before the last mirror. 'Step right up!' he cries. 'See yourself as you truly are! Only costs your soul!'
hall_of_mirrors_ringmaster.victory: The Ringmaster's hat rolls across the floor, and the carnival music stops.

study.text: He has no reflection. Look for the one man in the room with none.

aftermath.label: Leave the last mirror standing.
aftermath.text: It shows the empty room behind you, and something moving in it.

aftermath.label: Break the last mirror.
aftermath.text: It breaks into ten thousand pieces, and every piece shows you, screaming.

hall_of_mirrors_true_self.title: Your True Reflection
hall_of_mirrors_true_self.intro: The last mirror has given you up. Your reflection steps out of it, dressed like you, armed like you, and much less kind.
hall_of_mirrors_true_self.victory: Your reflection kneels and becomes glass again, then nothing.
hall_of_mirrors_true_self.arrival_omen: The last mirror shows the room, but you aren't in it.
hall_of_mirrors_true_self.arrival_rumour: The Hall of Mirrors in the market sends your own reflection to fight you. Only the strange come out.

study.text: It knows everything you know. Do something you would never do.

hall_of_mirrors_shard_swarm.title: the Shard Legion
hall_of_mirrors_shard_swarm.intro: Every shard of the broken mirror holds a reflection, and they have all come out to fight. Ten thousand of you, each one the size of a fingernail.
hall_of_mirrors_shard_swarm.victory: The Shard Legion falls like glittering rain.
hall_of_mirrors_shard_swarm.arrival_omen: Ten thousand glass shards hang in the air of the last room, turning slowly.
hall_of_mirrors_shard_swarm.arrival_rumour: Someone broke the last mirror in the carnival tent. Now the shards fly out at night.

study.text: They fly in a flock. Break the flock's leader.

hall_of_mirrors_empty_one.title: the Man Without a Reflection
hall_of_mirrors_empty_one.intro: A thin man stands among the mirrors and none of them show him. He has collected all the reflections he can. He wants yours.
hall_of_mirrors_empty_one.victory: The Man Without a Reflection falls, and every mirror in the hall shows him at last.
hall_of_mirrors_empty_one.arrival_omen: Every mirror in the hall now reflects only an empty room.
hall_of_mirrors_empty_one.arrival_rumour: Visitors to the Hall of Mirrors are coming out with no reflection. Something in there is collecting them.

study.text: He cannot see himself either. Lead him into the glass.

gates.name: the Cathedral of Bellfall
gates.description: A cathedral that sank into the ground during the Fracture, congregation and all. Its spire still pokes from a rift east of Verath, and its bells ring at midnight.
gates.entry_text: You enter through the belfry window and climb down into the nave. The pews are full. Nobody turns around.

rooms.text: The choir rises from its stalls and opens its mouths to sing. What comes out is not music.
The reliquary. A cracked bell rests on velvet.

check.success: You pray before you take it, and the bell does not ring.
check.fail: The bell rings as you lift it, and every head in the nave turns to look.

rooms.text: Gargoyles crawl down the walls from the spire.

bellfall_cathedral_bishop.title: Bishop {name}
bellfall_cathedral_bishop.intro: At the altar, the Bishop is still giving his sermon from the day the cathedral sank. Bishop {name} looks up. 'Sit,' he says, and your knees buckle.
bellfall_cathedral_bishop.victory: Bishop {name} finishes his sermon at last, and the congregation slumps in their pews.

study.text: His sermon has a last line. Say it for him.

bellfall_cathedral_bell_ringer.title: the Bell-Ringer
bellfall_cathedral_bell_ringer.intro: The Bishop's bell-ringer has come down from the belfry for the first time in a century. His ears bled out long ago. He rings anyway.
bellfall_cathedral_bell_ringer.victory: The Bell-Ringer falls with his hand still on the rope, and the bell gives a last, cracked toll.
bellfall_cathedral_bell_ringer.arrival_omen: The ropes in the belfry sway with no wind. Someone is climbing down.
bellfall_cathedral_bell_ringer.arrival_rumour: The bells of Bellfall Cathedral ring every hour now, not just at midnight. People in Verath can't sleep.

study.text: He's deaf. Come at him from behind.

bellfall_cathedral_congregation.title: the Risen Congregation
bellfall_cathedral_congregation.intro: Your arcane arts woke the whole congregation at once. They stand from the pews as one, singing, and there are hundreds of them.
bellfall_cathedral_congregation.victory: The congregation sits down, all together, and is still.
bellfall_cathedral_congregation.arrival_omen: Every pew is empty. Hundreds of footprints lead up the aisle to the altar.
bellfall_cathedral_congregation.arrival_rumour: The congregation of Bellfall Cathedral has stood up. They're walking the aisle, singing.

study.text: They follow the hymn. Break the hymn.

bellfall_cathedral_angel_of_bells.title: the Angel of the Bells
bellfall_cathedral_angel_of_bells.intro: A figure of bronze and light hangs from the belfry like a bell itself, its wings made of bell-shaped feathers. It was carved for the cathedral. Now it has come to life to guard it.
bellfall_cathedral_angel_of_bells.victory: The Angel of the Bells rings out one last pure note and goes silent.
bellfall_cathedral_angel_of_bells.arrival_omen: The statue that used to stand in the belfry is gone. A bronze feather lies on the altar.
bellfall_cathedral_angel_of_bells.arrival_rumour: An angel guards the belfry of Bellfall Cathedral now. It rings when it strikes.

study.text: It is hollow. Strike it hard enough and it rings, and ringing stuns it.
